title: Pretty but not the easiest to use
text: Pretty but not the easiest to use. The slits are kinda big (I have other glass filters, and not all are this big) so often leaves get stuck in the slits or they are able to come through. It's pretty, but the cure actually make it's harder to fill and pull out the filter without making a bit of a mess.  It's my spare at work, so I'll keep it, but won't order again.
